svg.title: Original lotus, 160-column pixel translation, light palette, rest state
svg.desc: The supplied lotus outline translated directly into editable one-unit square cells. Preserves the source contour, asymmetry, petal layering, tapered line weight, open ends, long side petals, downward-left petal, and stamens. Source pixels are sampled in exact 12 by 12 squares without stretching. 8 transparent cells of padding. Resting state is magenta. Hover mock adds an identical teal mask displaced 2 cells right and 1 up, with no shape morphing. Background and petal interiors are transparent.
